description: This source file defines API routes for a memory card game backend, including endpoints to create, retrieve, flip, and reset game sessions. It uses FastAPI to define HTTP endpoints, models for request and response schemas, and interacts with a MemoryGameService for game logic.

classes.name: ErrorResponse
classes.description: Standard error response schema for API errors.

classes.name: FlipRequest
classes.description: Request body model for flipping a card.

classes.name: ResetGameResponse
classes.description: Response model indicating a game reset completed, including the new game session view.

methods.name: GameSessionView create_game(payload: NewGameRequest = Body(...))
methods.description: Creates a new game session and returns the initial game state.

methods.name: GameSessionView get_game( gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Unique identifier of the game session."), )
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a game session by its UUID.

methods.name: FlipResult flip_card( gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Unique identifier of the game session."), payload: FlipRequest = Body(...), )
methods.description: Flip a specific card in the game session and return the flip result.

methods.name: ResetGameResponse reset_game( gameId: UUID = Path(..., description="Unique identifier of the game session."), )
methods.description: Resets an existing game session by creating a new one with the same board size.
